title: Pick by *expiry*, not by arrival
subtitle: FEFO: First Expired, First Out. Four controls make it real.

stages.name: Receive
stages.desc: Capture lot and expiry date on every pallet at the dock, not later.

stages.name: Put away
stages.desc: Never park new pallets in front of older dates in the same bay.

stages.name: Pick
stages.desc: The system directs the nearest expiry first, whenever it arrived.

stages.name: Check
stages.desc: Hold lots below the customer's minimum shelf life before dispatch.

takeaway: Remaining shelf life % = days to expiry ÷ total shelf life x 100

author.name: Hammad Ulhaq
author.role: Head of Supply Chain · 20+ yrs FMCG & Beverages
